scripts.build:bundle: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist/bundle', {recursive: true, force: true})" && esbuild server/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:jembadb --outfile=dist/bundle/index.js
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:client && npm run build:bundle && node build/prepkg.js linux && node build/pkg-with-conditional.js node22-linux-x64 dist/linux/inpx-web dist/bundle/index.js
scripts.build:linux-arm64: npm run build:client && npm run build:bundle && node build/prepkg.js linux-arm64 && node build/pkg-with-conditional.js node22-linux-arm64 dist/linux-arm64/inpx-web dist/bundle/index.js
scripts.build:win: npm run build:client && npm run build:bundle && node build/prepkg.js win && node build/pkg-with-conditional.js node22-win-x64 dist/win/inpx-web dist/bundle/index.js
scripts.build:macos: npm run build:client && npm run build:bundle && node build/prepkg.js macos && node build/pkg-with-conditional.js node22-macos-x64 dist/macos/inpx-web dist/bundle/index.js
scripts.build:all: npm run build:linux && npm run build:win && npm run build:macos && npm run build:linux-arm64
scripts.release:linux: npm run build:linux && node build/release.js linux
scripts.release:win: npm run build:win && node build/release.js win
scripts.release:macos: npm run build:macos && node build/release.js macos
scripts.release:arm64: npm run build:linux-arm64 && node build/release.js arm64
